cells.gaps: No source since October 2023 says a digital or biometric roll is in service; a biometric list is in preparation (MDG-003), which does not count for a roll kept by hand.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-04, 2 to 1, under Bill's ruling of 2026-11-03 (messages-for-bill 71): the August 2026 overhaul collects voter data mainly on paper forms (MDG-004), so the roll is kept by hand.
